output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01') - SUM(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE order_date < DATE '2025-01-01')) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'), 0), 2) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE is_revenue
  AND order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Revenue is taken as net_revenue on orders flagged is_revenue, assigned to a year by order_date. The result is the percentage change from calendar year 2024 to calendar year 2025: (2025 − 2024) / 2024 × 100. A negative value means revenue fell, and NULL means there was no 2024 revenue to compare against.
